correctness.rationale: For compact metrizable G and Haar-measurable A with alpha in (0,1], every countable translate mixture integrates to alpha, so Jensen gives lower bound -log2(alpha). For upper bound, iid Haar translates with weights 2^-k yield a positive-a.e. baseline a0 with integrable -log2(a0) because first hits are geometric with mean 1/alpha. Finite iid translate averages have exponentially small lower-tail bad sets by Hoeffding and Fubini. An epsilon admixture of a0 controls the log singularity on these sets by absolute continuity of its integrable majorant. Limits N→∞, then epsilon and delta→0 prove the infimum exactly; alpha=1 is immediate. Borel-mod-null representatives make the Fubini step valid for completed Haar measurability. No attainment claim is made.
